refine_summary: The initial run failed because the SARC-ZORA-TZVP basis set was not available for Titanium (Ti). I replaced the basis set with ZORA-def2-TZVP and added AutoAux to ensure auxiliary basis sets are generated automatically. The second run timed out (likely due to the calculation complexity being too high for the environment's short timeout), but the input structure is now technically correct for ORCA. All mandatory blocks (keywords, basis, cpcm, method, scf, rel, geometry, output, tddft) are preserved.
